title: Two-species system with nonlocal interactions driven by Riesz potentials
summary: This paper investigates a system of nonlocal continuity equations modelling the interaction of two species coupled through Riesz-type potentials. The model incorporates self- and cross-interaction kernels of possibly different fractional orders. By exploiting optimal transportation theory and the theory of gradient flows in Wasserstein spaces, we establish the existence of weak solutions under singularity assumptions on all interaction potentials, provided the cross-interaction ones satisfy a symmetry condition.
